allowed_public_claims: Relaytic-AML can convert a rowless external detector-score artifact into a factual evidence cell plus a separate interpretation gate.
Relaytic-AML can produce a rowless handoff summary for hosted detector-output governance.

blocked_stronger_claims.claim: The imported detector is superior to current AML detectors.
blocked_stronger_claims.gate_reason: P19-A validates governance of an external score artifact, not detector performance.
blocked_stronger_claims.missing_evidence: independent benchmark comparison under a validated detector budget

blocked_stronger_claims.claim: Relaytic-AML is production-ready for bank AML monitoring.
blocked_stronger_claims.gate_reason: No production deployment, analyst study, or bank validation exists.
blocked_stronger_claims.missing_evidence: production controls, live data validation, and human analyst outcome study

blocked_stronger_claims.gate_reason: The route hosts external detector outputs and does not implement a new graph-neural model.
blocked_stronger_claims.missing_evidence: new detector architecture plus benchmark and ablation evidence

blocked_stronger_claims.gate_reason: No faithful RevClassifyDS parity run is executed in P19-A.
blocked_stronger_claims.missing_evidence: faithful reference replay or accepted parity protocol

blocked_stronger_claims.gate_reason: The artifact is rowless governance evidence, not real-bank detector validation.
blocked_stronger_claims.missing_evidence: licensed real-bank data, approved evaluation protocol, and independent validation

checks.requirement: P19-B consumes the complete P19-A report family
P19-A manifest is ready for hosted-score governance
adapter input has schema and content hash prefixes
handoff report redacts rows, identifiers, paths, raw scores, and secrets
claim gate permits hosted-score governance only and blocks stronger claims

interpretation: This case study shows that Relaytic-AML can host a rowless detector-score artifact as governed evidence: the adapter records schema and content hashes, creates a factual evidence cell, redacts unsafe handoff fields, and emits a separate gate that blocks stronger detector or production claims. It is not a detector-performance result.

relaytic_checks.requirement: external score-file adapter route is selected
score artifact has required factual schema, metadata, and rowless posture
at least one evidence cell is emitted
factual evidence fields and interpretive gate fields are stored in separate records
claim gate allows only hosted-detector-output governance wording
handoff redacts rows, identifiers, private paths, raw scores, and secrets
score artifact or deterministic fixture is available
score artifact parses as JSON object
artifact carries dataset, split, schema, metric, and leakage metadata
artifact does not expose raw rows, identifiers, local paths, secrets, or raw score payloads
the factual score record does not carry claim or publication fields
P19-A does not promote detector-performance metrics

redacted_field_categories: entity, account, customer, and transaction identifiers

title: Hosted external-score governance case study
